notes.title: Final Update!
notes.content:
Dear players, thank you for being with us on this development journey! 

We had a lot of fun making this game!

Thank you for being with us even when the updates were scarce!


In this final update we polished the game a lot, here is everything that we made:

- added better controller support: the players playing with a controller have a smoother experience
- voice over: if reading is not your thing, the long texts now have their own audio, so you don't have to read if you don't want to
- better music: we expanded our background music
- achievements correction: some achievements weren't working properly, now this should be fixed
- reward tiers correction: some rewards were awarded to the player prematurely, this should be fixed now

As always, backup your save files before updating!

Have fun racing!

notes.title: Complete Game Rework
notes.content:
This game has been reworked from it's core! We must admit that during development we have shifted a lot from the original idea! But now everything is going how we imagined it!

This game is now what it was intended to be: a Random Generated Racing Game.

We have added:
- random level generation (every level is different)
- sounds
- better flying controls
- better joystick controls
- save system (now you can save your XP)

Good luck in your races and enjoy the flight!
